scientific_limitations: Only the 17-vertex Paley graph and the two-independence cutoff are classified.
The character covers a specified order-136 affine automorphism subgroup.
The orbit space is proved rationally acyclic, not contractible.
Publication priority is not independently established; an unindexed equivalent calculation remains possible.
title: Integral sphere-wedge topology and affine symmetry of a Paley higher-independence complex
